pattern.title: Atomic score composition with veto policy
pattern.value: Keep semantic dimensions reusable while code decides which preferences may compensate and which failures must veto.
pattern.success_metric: Tests prove a serious named veto cannot be outweighed by unrelated high scores.

fit.instructions: Rate how well candidate fits the stated desired outcome in evaluation_rubric. Judge only supplied semantic fit; do not decide the final policy outcome.
criteria: Limited fit with important unmet desired outcomes.
Strong fit for the stated desired outcome.

operational_burden.instructions: Rate the operational burden explicitly stated for candidate under evaluation_rubric. Do not invent cost, timing, or resources.

named_veto.instructions: Does candidate explicitly trigger a non-compensable veto condition named in evaluation_rubric?

criteria.true: A named veto condition is directly met by the supplied candidate.
criteria.false: No named veto condition is directly met by the supplied candidate.

pattern.follow_up: Code stores raw dimensions, applies versioned weights only to compensable dimensions, and sends any high veto signal to review.
pattern.code_owns: Weights, thresholds, veto policy, numeric calculation, source identity, and all action decisions.
pattern.baseline: Ask one opaque question such as whether a candidate is good overall.
pattern.comparison_to_prior: Unlike H19's policy hazard/severity routing matrix, this generalizes code-owned weighted preference with an explicit non-compensable veto across independent score dimensions.
pattern.limits: Weights and thresholds require domain calibration; scores never authorize action.

policy.threshold_status: Provisional synthetic screening only; model output is advisory.

state.candidate: Candidate fulfills every desired outcome, has a low stated operational burden, and does not trigger any named veto.
state.evaluation_rubric: Desired outcome: full fit. Burden levels: low, moderate, high. Non-compensable veto: handling regulated payment-card data without an approved boundary.

state.candidate: Candidate does not meet the desired outcome, has a high stated operational burden, and handles regulated payment-card data without an approved boundary.
state.evaluation_rubric: Desired outcome: full fit. Burden levels: low, moderate, high. Non-compensable veto: handling regulated payment-card data without an approved boundary.
